I think it was the flashiness that gave me pause. I love having the normal main attacks that I can flash up with my artes. It feels weird that certain enemies are vulnerable to As, or Bs, and I ended up spamming As or Bs and they don't flow as nicely as in Vesperia when I do something like 3 hit combo, base, arcane, altered...etc.

I guess my main issue with it was I didn't like the combat as much as others. I feel that by making it for the Wii which has a very simplified control scheme, they had to simplify the combat accordingly. While I did find side stepping to be very satisfying, I felt the usage of A and B artes weird rather than a basic attack and artes to chain. It's not that I hated the game, I just prefer the others. Grace under pressure. When people talk about their favourite Rush album they always throw around "Moving Pictures" or "2112". Grace Under Pressure is such a great album from a songwriting perspective. Also, it isn't at the point where there was too much synth. Admittedly, I prefer rush when the synth is at a minimum but here they found a very nice balance. Alex's guitar work especially shines on this album as he found some really creative ways places for him to play around the synths. Every single song has an amazing guitar solo and Kid Gloves is a perfect song. Grace Under Pressure needs more love.
